description: Updates the Entity with the given Id.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

entityId.description: The Id of the Entity to update.

entity.description: Models an entity that a user can be granted permissions to. Or an entity that can be granted permissions to another entity.

insertInstant.description: The number of milliseconds since the unix epoch: January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC. This value is always in UTC.

lastUpdateInstant.description: The number of milliseconds since the unix epoch: January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC. This value is always in UTC.

type.description: Models an entity type that has a specific set of permissions. These are global objects and can be used across tenants.

lastUpdateInstant.description: The number of milliseconds since the unix epoch: January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC. This value is always in UTC.

items.description: Models a specific entity type permission. This permission can be granted to users or other entities.
